run_bloat_diff: run the bloat diff tool to compare binary size between two gRPC commits
run_bloat_diff_with_base: run the bloat diff tool with a diff base commit to compare library bloat
build_grpc_libraries: build the gRPC shared libraries using cmake and make in a specified output directory
analyze_library_bloat: analyze the bloat of libgrpc.so and libgrpc++.so using the bloaty binary analysis tool
check_on_pr_bloat: post the bloat difference results to a pull request using check_on_pr
